tldr: Mars through the 12th house heats up rest, retreat, privacy, hidden pressure, and endings.
body:
When Mars moves through your 12th house, it adds heat and urgency to rest, retreat, privacy, hidden pressure, exhaustion, endings, and what you are not ready to explain. You may notice what is happening out of sight: fatigue, unfinished feelings, private pressure, or the need to step back before you can understand what comes next.

You may feel more impatient, motivated, protective, desirous, or ready to act. It can help you move something that has been stuck.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for giving yourself space to process what cannot be solved by pushing harder.

The caution: Watch for reacting before you know what you are actually trying to change. The risk is disappearing into avoidance when what you really need is rest, honesty, and quiet support.

Mars moves through this house for about six weeks. Give the pressure a useful outlet. Act with a target, not just a charge.
